system.description:
A shimmering ward surrounds you. The next spell that targets you before the ward fades is deflected back at its caster, contested by a Cast check.

Scaling: At dice count 3, you gain advantage on the contested check. At dice count 6, a failed contest still negates the spell's effect on you entirely. At dice count 9, the ward deflects the next two spells instead of one. At dice count 12, deflected spells deal an extra 1d6 damage of their type. At dice count 15, the ward reflects any spell automatically, no contest required.
